verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public GitHub repository (modal-labs/modal-client) containing the JS and Go SDKs for Modal Sandboxes, so the client-side code is readable. Nothing shows the sandbox platform or backend itself is public, and no license is stated for the client repo. missing for 10: source for the sandbox runtime/backend, an explicit open-source license, documentation of what is open versus proprietary, and independent corroboration.
